releases.body:
Threadforge 1.0.5 adds a broader MCP and skills catalogue, configurable terminal choices and compact connection management.

### Changes

- 68 connection entries and authored workflows in ten skill categories, with vendor-sourced artwork and category-preserving migration/import/export.
- Bundled Nano Banana `generate_image` and `edit_image` tools through the official Gemini SDK. Includes encrypted API-key storage, reviewed reference-image uploads, configurable output folders, new-file results and image previews. Gemini API billing is separate from manual Gemini website access. Google's banana emoji symbol is used for this entry.
- 29 saved visibility switches in Settings → Terminal for system shells, agent CLIs, cloud CLIs and developer tools. Adds explicit PowerShell, CMD and Git Bash choices; Cursor Agent and the other CLI entries open in workspace terminal panes. WSL is not installed or required.
- Working Manage connection and Disconnect actions, plus saved agent-access editing without reconnecting or changing credentials. Account and removal actions remain in management. Endpoint editing is available after disconnecting.
- Matching compact catalogue/connected cards, equal-width actions, compact dialog buttons and clearer connection-note spacing.
- Follow-up terminal/account-picker controls, sidebar and floating agent-question improvements included since 1.0.4.

### Validation

One complete source run passes 1,912 tests across 310 files. One Windows file-symlink case is skipped; the remaining reference-boundary checks run normally. TypeScript, main/host/renderer builds and lint pass with zero lint errors and 122 existing warnings. The synthetic 48,000-chunk terminal workload retains exact bounded output and releases the tested listeners and sessions.

Both Windows x64 packages are checked statically for current compiled files, native dependencies, TF artwork, host version, connection/terminal contracts, embedded payload integrity and matching update metadata. Source/browser/static package verification does not represent installed desktop UI, physical audio or real provider/MCP account testing. Nano Banana tests use a mocked Gemini SDK and do not make a billable request.

Download the installer or portable below. Close an existing Threadforge instance before testing this build so the single-instance lock does not route the launch to the older application. `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers the published filenames; the remaining assets support automatic updates.


## Thread Toolbox

The Toolbox ZIP contains the application payload from the original release above, without rebuilding or running it. Install it through Thread Toolbox; the original downloads are also retained.

# Threadnote 0.1.0

First GitHub release of Threadnote, a local-first notes app for Windows x64.

## Highlights

- Rich-text notes with blocks, attachments, links, tags and full-text search.
- Workspaces, folders, tabs, favorites, trash and customizable sidebar navigation.
- Databases with table, board, gallery, list, calendar, timeline, feed and chart views.
- Persistent free layouts, canvas and global/local note graphs.
- My tasks, quick notes, Markdown import/export and local backups.
- Thread Apps launchers and selected imports, ThreadCalendar integration and scoped ThreadForge MCP access.
- Meeting notes with system audio and optional microphone capture, local Whisper transcription, retry/recovery and opt-in meeting detection.

## Downloads

- **Threadnote-0.1.0-setup.exe**: Windows x64 installer with an installation-location wizard and shortcuts.
- **Threadnote-0.1.0-portable.exe**: standalone Windows x64 executable; data is stored in ThreadnoteData beside it.
- **SHA256SUMS.txt**: SHA-256 checksums for the attached binaries and installer metadata.

Installed builds store notes under %APPDATA%/threadnote/ by default. Settings > Data can select another folder. Whisper's runtime and multilingual model are set up separately from the meeting panel.

These Windows builds are unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may prompt on first run. Automatic meeting detection is best effort; browser calls can require a manual Stop and save.

## Validation

- 528 tests passed across 58 test files.
- TypeScript checks, ESLint and production builds passed.
- Packaged bundles, migrations and application icon checked against the release sources.

Source commit: 9b5216779860121470dd2e805cd49ba36b8d32b3.

First Windows desktop release of ThreadStorage.

## Download

Install **ThreadStorage_0.1.2_x64-setup.exe** on Windows x64. The current-user installer includes the verified rclone 1.75.1 transfer engine. SHA256 checksums and build metadata are attached.

## Included

- Cloud connections for Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box, pCloud, S3, WebDAV/Nextcloud, SFTP and SMB/NAS, plus local folders and computer drives.
- Storage dashboard, file previews, cached folder listings and managed offline copies.
- One-way and two-way synchronization, conflict preservation, transfer progress, cancellation and retry.
- Single-use QR pairing with remembered phones and authenticated HTTPS file transfers over LAN or Tailscale.
- English and Georgian interfaces, appearance settings, startup animation and tray support.

## Validation

20 UI tests, 40 Rust tests and the transfer-engine smoke test passed. Rust tests include real HTTPS interoperability with the production mobile Go receiver. The Windows production frontend and NSIS installer built successfully.

## Current limits

QR pairing requires compatible device-pairing-v2 builds of [Android](https://github.com/xheavy0/ThreadstorageAndroid) or [iOS](https://github.com/xheavy0/ThreadstorageIOS). Physical Android/iPhone acceptance over LAN and Tailscale remains pending. Fresh OAuth consent and authenticated cloud transfers require provider/account verification; Google Drive requires your own OAuth desktop client credentials. See the README for setup and sync semantics.

The Windows installer is unsigned.

The Toolbox ZIP contains the application payload from the original release above, without rebuilding or running it. Install it through Thread Toolbox; the original downloads are also retained.

# ThreadVoice 0.1.0

First GitHub release of ThreadVoice for Windows x64.

## Install

Download **ThreadVoice-Setup-0.1.0.exe** and run the installer. Setup installs for the current user and creates desktop and Start menu shortcuts. Node.js is bundled and does not need to be installed separately.

Add your own OpenAI API key in **Settings → Connection**. Dictation and voice conversations require an internet connection and paid OpenAI API access.

## Features

- System-wide Georgian and English dictation: hold **Ctrl + Win**, speak, and release to insert text at the cursor. Double-tap for hands-free dictation.
- Voice commands for rewriting selected text or generating new text with **Ctrl + Win + Alt**.
- AI formatting, per-app writing styles, a custom dictionary, and spoken snippets.
- Live voice conversations with an animated audio sphere, selectable voices, transcripts, and separate microphone and reply mute controls.
- A redesigned control panel and floating widget, dark/light/system themes, custom accents, and smoother dragging across displays.
- Dictation history, word statistics, retries for failed recordings, and an animated startup with reduced-motion support.

## Notes

- The Windows installer is unsigned.
- The OpenAI API key is encrypted for the current Windows account. Uninstalling preserves settings and history.
- Elevated administrator windows do not receive dictation input. Georgian dictation requires the online service.

## Validation

- 152 automated tests passed.
- TypeScript type checking passed.
- A fresh Windows x64 NSIS installer was built; emitted and packaged modules passed the build checks.
- Built from commit `a6be00e528a3429468fcabbc586f0bcda6443775`.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains checksums for the installer and its release metadata.

ThreadAccount 0.3.2 ამატებს Windows-ის საინსტალაციო ვერსიას.

## ინსტალაცია

ჩამოტვირთეთ `ThreadAccount-0.3.2-Setup.exe` და გაუშვით. ინსტალაციის ოსტატი გაძლევთ საქაღალდის არჩევის საშუალებას, ქმნის Start Menu-ის ჩანაწერსა და Desktop-ის მალსახმობს და ამატებს აპის წაშლის შესაძლებლობას Windows-ის Installed apps-ში.

განახლებისას ჯერ დახურეთ აპის ძველი ვერსია. ინსტალირებულ ვერსიაში შენარჩუნებულია არსებული ანგარიშებისა და workspace-ის პარამეტრების შენახვის ადგილი.

## ცვლილებები

- Windows installer გახდა სტანდარტული გამოშვების ფორმატი (`npm run dist`).
- პროექტის გამშვები ხსნის ინსტალირებულ აპს ან ინსტალაციის ოსტატს.
- ცალკე portable build კვლავ შესაძლებელია `npm run dist:portable` ბრძანებით.
- შენარჩუნებულია 0.3.1-ის ინტერფეისი: გაზრდილი ფონტი, Thread Toolbox-ის მსგავსი dropdown მენიუები, რედაქტირებადი workspace-ის სახელი, გახსნილი გვერდის სქროლი და Model activity-ში **Provider → Model** რიგი.

მიბმული `SHA256SUMS.txt` შეიცავს საინსტალაციო ფაილის SHA-256 საკონტროლო ჯამს.

# Threadplan 1.0.0

First GitHub release of Threadplan for Windows x64 and Android: offline tasks, habits, calendar and JSON backups with the shared redesigned interface.

## Downloads

- **Windows installer:** `Threadplan-1.0.0-windows-x64-setup.exe`. Installs for the current user and downloads Microsoft Edge WebView2 if it is missing.
- **Windows portable:** `Threadplan-1.0.0-windows-x64-portable.zip`. Extract and run `Threadplan.exe`; WebView2 must already be installed.
- **Android:** `Threadplan-1.0.0-android-preview.apk`. Android 7.0/API 24 or newer; ARM64 and x86_64; package `com.threadplan.app`, version 1.0.0, build 10.
- **Checksums:** `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all three packages.

Windows binaries are unsigned development builds. Android is a release-mode build signed with the existing local preview/debug key; it is not a Play Store submission.

## Included

- Tasks with notes, priorities, categories, date/time scheduling, recurrence, search, filters, completion and restore; Today and calendar views.
- Habits with schedules, quantitative goals, history, streaks and statistics.
- Local English/Georgian quick-add parsing with an editable review form.
- Android task/habit reminders, reminder diagnostics and Today/Habits home-screen widgets.
- Windows Tauri 2/Rust shell with native SQLite and reviewed JSON backup import/export.
- Shared appearance settings: themes, text size, button/navigation/icon colors, local background images, six background effects, opacity, blur, glass and interface scale.
- Optional Windows ThreadVoice task dictation using the existing ThreadVoice profile and the user's OpenAI API account. Android voice input uses an installed on-device model.

## Data and upgrades

Windows retains `com.threadplan.desktop` and stores its database at `%APPDATA%\com.threadplan.desktop\threadplan.db`. Schema 8 and existing forward migrations are preserved. No database reset or new migration was introduced for this release.

Export a JSON backup before moving between installations. Existing Electron/browser profiles remain in their original storage; transfer through the reviewed JSON import flow. JSON import replaces records after confirmation. Backups are not encrypted. Android OS automatic backup is disabled.

## Validation and limits

Source commit: `1ab097ffd214513bae6d70614dc56c5672cf69bd`.

Release validation includes TypeScript, ESLint, 121 shared tests, 9 Rust tests, 2 Windows native SQLite integration tests, 2 Android widget JVM tests, web/Android exports, Windows installer build and Android APK build/signature verification.

Native WebView2 launch, installer/dialog interaction, Android launch/widget/reminder delivery, physical-device behavior and real-microphone transcription remain unverified for this release under the project's browser-only UI rule. Windows reminder delivery, notification navigation, background scheduling and offline speech remain pending. Interface labels remain English; there is no cloud sync.
